definitions.explanation: Making something better through modifications or enhancements.

examples.japanese: {製品|せいひん}を{改良|かいりょう}した。
{品種|ひんしゅ}{改良|かいりょう}に{成功|せいこう}した。
{土壌|どじょう}{改良|かいりょう}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。

notes:
{改良|かいりょう} means making something better through concrete, incremental modifications. It emphasizes practical, tangible improvements rather than abstract or systemic change.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive) as する verb
- 〜を{改良|かいりょう}する (to improve ~)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {品種|ひんしゅ}{改良|かいりょう} (breed improvement)
- {土壌|どじょう}{改良|かいりょう} (soil improvement)
- {改良|かいりょう}{版|ばん} (improved version)
- {改良|かいりょう}を{加|くわ}える (to add improvements)
- {改良|かいりょう}を{重|かさ}ねる (to make repeated improvements)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {改善|かいぜん}: improvement (systems, processes, conditions — often abstract)
- {改造|かいぞう}: remodeling, modification (large structural changes)
- {改正|かいせい}: revision (laws, rules — institutional)
- {改良|かいりょう}: improvement (products, materials, breeds — concrete/physical)
